_comment: Ford Mode 22 (enhanced) PIDs for the dashboard. Entries are UNVERIFIED community values unless verified is true. TPMS DIDs 2813-2816 (BCM 726) were verified by Dale on a 2017 F-150. OSS DID 1E13 stays UNVERIFIED. Edit Data\ford-enhanced-pids.json to fix them: value = (raw * scale) + offset, raw = big-endian 'bytes' after 62 DID DID (two's complement if signed). 'map' turns a raw integer into a label. Read-only service 22 only.

pids.name: Transmission gear (GEAR_OSC)
pids.source: f150ecoboost.net 'custom PIDs for Torque' (221E12, equation A); raw-to-gear mapping is a guess, 10R80 values unknown

pids.name: Output shaft speed (OSS)
pids.source: UNVERIFIED. Ford PID name OSS / OSS_SRC (Ford expanded PID list). No confirmed community DID for 6R80/10R80 was found: 1E13 is a guess in the 1E1x transmission block (1E12 gear, 1E14 TC slip, 1E15 slip ratio, 1E1C TFT on 6.7L/F-150 Torque lists); scale ((A*256)+B)/4 rpm follows Ford's other speed PIDs. Polled on PCM 7E0 first, then TCM 7E1 (10R80 trucks with a separate TCM). Check against speed: OSS ~ mph x axle ratio x 336 / tire diameter (in).

pids.name: Transmission gear actual (?)
pids.source: Placeholder DID suggested for 'gear actual'; no confirmed source. Disabled by default.

pids.name: Tire pressure LF
pids.source: Verified by Dale on a 2017 F-150. BCM 726 Mode 22 DID 2813 (LF). Formula remains the Torque Pro community equation (((256*A)+B)/3+22/3) kPa.
